text:
nina: heads-up vendor-zenithcargo just notified H100 eu ETA slipping 6d -> ~13d due to terminal dwell + customs reclassification backlog. this will impact Dedicated EU capacity for the mid-month wave.

vendor-zenithcargo: confirmed. options: (A) hot-lift 12 units via air (ETA 48-72h) surcharge $2.9k/unit; (B) full ocean 24 units (eta 12-14d) no surcharge; (C) consolidated split 12 air + 12 sea. we can include preprinted rma-return labels inside each crate and crate-level acceptance photos if amendment signed. observed depot burn-in ~0.7% for last month.

maya: can you upload an ETA matrix + serial manifest csv and sample depot photo checklist? we need the exact rma label format to validate our scanner.

vendor-zenithcargo: will upload manifest and checklist in 90m. rma label format: ZEN_{depot}_{po}_{serial}. depot requires crate photos within 24h or they may reject warranty intake.

sam: quick cost delta calc for 12 air units vs waiting for ocean:

```
air_cost = 12 * 2900 = 34800
wait_cost = 0 (but miss launch)
```

sam: air cost = $34.8k. alternate: borrow 8 units from partner pool in frankfurt (transfer & customs ~ $7.5k). delta ~ $27.3k. is missing launch acceptable?

liam: launch target = +30 gpus in EU by D+5. current eu slack = 9. if we take 12 air + 12 sea => slack +12 = 21 (still short 9). borrowing 8 partner units gets us to 29 (short 1). need to consider loaners + hot-lift to be safe.

ops-eu: we can free up 3 GPUs from reserved test racks (reimage time ~8h) but cross-dc transfers take >=7d. frankfurt partner loaners require MOU and will arrive ~3d.

nina: prioritize feature launch. @procurement-bot open PO amendment: include 12 air hot-lift, spare policy 3 spares per 150_units (or pro-rata), crate photos <=24h SLA, rma label in-box, and manifest csv with columns: serial, sku, shipped_ts, depot_id, photo_md5, burnin_flag. flag finance for one-off expedite spend.

procurement-bot: PO 77331_amendment created, routing to @finance. includes spare line-items and rma label requirement.

vendor-zenithcargo: note: some depots will only accept warranty if photos are uploaded by our ops partner within 24h and the photo_md5 matches manifest. we will pre-staple rma labels inside crates and include a manifest QR on crate exterior for scanning.

maya: agree to SLA. add clause: rma pickup window <=72h for failed units and vendor must provide pickup ticket id in manifest. also require vendor to mark crate-level burn-in failures in the csv.

sam: approve 12 air + 3 spares (pro-rata). finance needs to approve the $34.8k expedite. attach cost center 4150 if approved.

finance: approve one-off expedite up to $40k under cost center 4150. vendor please send amended invoice and detailed cost allocation.

nina: vendor, send final amended invoice + serial manifest + crate photo checklist. ops-eu, prep depot for 24h photo SLA and rma pickup staging.

vendor-zenithcargo: final invoice and manifest uploaded (files: zen_invoice_77331.pdf, manifest_1749995555.csv). Air AWB: ZEN-AIR-77 (ETA 48-72h). Ocean BL: ZEN-BL-099 (eta 12-14d). included 3 spares across the shipment and printed rma labels taped inside each crate.

ops-eu: noted — will confirm depot contacts and ensure photo upload workflow. pls include depot SFTP + webhook for photo ingest.

liam: set a dashboard card: wave=1749995555, track burn-in percent, photo_turnaround_hours, rma_pickup_time. alert if burn-in >0.7% or photo_turnaround >24h.

nina: procurement-bot mark PO amended & vendor confirmed once invoice is reconciled. saving thread for post-wave RMA metrics.

procurement-bot: PO 77331_amendment -> vendor confirmed -> invoice routed to finance. thread will auto-archive in 45d.

sam: thanks everyone. after arrival ops please post crate-level burn-in numbers and RMA pickup ids so we can evaluate whether spare inclusion reduced outage risk.
